findings.title: Default administrator credentials are prefilled and stored in client code
findings.evidence: The login form contains prefilled email/password values; main.js also declares the same credentials and initializes users in localStorage.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Remove secrets from static assets and replace client-only authentication in an explicitly authorized security pass.

findings.title: Five subject modules emit a progress message Main does not accept
findings.evidence: The shared runtime emits SUBJECT_FEEDBACK while Main accepts BAUMAN_SUBJECT_PROGRESS or BAUMAN_PROGRESS_REPORT.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Define one versioned, origin-checked progress envelope before wiring all modules to it.

findings.title: Stage labels conflict across Main, Math, and Roadmap V2
findings.evidence: Main declares GĐ1-GĐ3, while Roadmap V2 requires GĐ0-GĐ3; Math contains both GĐ1-GĐ3 and GĐ0-GĐ9 definitions.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Adopt one canonical stage registry and migrate labels only after the L32 transition design is accepted.

findings.title: Physical UI exposes eight modules while the accepted target curriculum has ten courses
findings.evidence: The pinned repository has eight subject entrypoints; the L30 target disposition contains ten target courses.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Design an additive 8-to-10 transition mapping; do not delete legacy modules.

findings.title: Quiz size copy conflicts with the implemented maximum
findings.evidence: The shared UI advertises 20/30/40/50 questions but startTest slices every test to at most ten.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Align display and selection rules through a validated assessment blueprint.

findings.title: Shared modules allow direct lesson completion without an evidence gate
findings.evidence: The shared lesson UI calls markLessonDone directly from a completion button and does not require evidence from the accepted mastery model.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Route completion through the evidence-backed mastery transition designed in L24.

findings.title: Shared JSON import validates syntax but does not complete a durable import workflow
findings.evidence: The shared data action parses JSON and displays manual-copy guidance instead of applying a validated migration transaction.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Specify import validation, conflict handling, rollback, and user confirmation before persistence work at L34.

findings.title: Five subjects use byte-identical generic JavaScript and CSS runtimes
findings.evidence: All five runtime scripts share one Git blob SHA and all five styles share another, despite distinct subject domains.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Separate shared shell behavior from course-specific labs and assessment adapters.

findings.title: Legacy UI has no representation for the accepted control-plane states
findings.evidence: The audited entrypoints do not expose Diagnostic, six-state mastery, dependency eligibility, readiness, or Master Mode semantics.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Create a read-only presentation model before any UI mutation.

findings.title: Shared subject assistant is keyword lookup rather than an evidence-aware tutor
findings.evidence: Responses are selected by local keyword matching and are not grounded in current lesson evidence or readiness state.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Define grounding, citations, refusal, and scope rules before expanding assistant behavior.

findings.title: Legacy progress is a local percentage rather than the accepted mastery projection
findings.evidence: Local completion percentages are persisted independently of the append-only evidence and readiness contracts.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Treat legacy percentage as a labeled compatibility signal, never as Master-ready evidence.

findings.title: Cross-frame messages use wildcard delivery without origin/source validation
findings.evidence: Subject messages target '*' and the Main receiver filters type but does not authenticate event.origin or event.source.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Pin allowed origins, validate the source window and schema, and reject unknown versions.

findings.title: Math uses a heterogeneous patch-stack entrypoint
findings.evidence: Math loads multiple patch scripts and the default-OFF Roadmap bridge, while its planning bridge exists but is not directly loaded by the entrypoint.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Document load order and ownership before normalizing adapters.

findings.title: Visible form controls across all legacy routes lack programmatically associated names
findings.evidence: Real Chromium observed 17 visible unlabeled controls across two viewports: Main 4; AI, Foundation, Research, Signal, and Systems 2 each; Math, Programming, and Russian 1 each. Hidden controls and controls nested in label elements are excluded.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Add visible labels, programmatic names, errors, and a verified keyboard focus order in the authorized UI pass.

findings.title: Widespread innerHTML rendering requires a data-flow security review
findings.evidence: Multiple runtimes construct interface fragments with innerHTML; this audit does not claim exploitability without tracing each input source.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Trace trust boundaries and replace unsafe sinks where untrusted content can reach them.

findings.title: Current Bauman Subjects cannot be represented as static guessed curriculum
findings.evidence: L30 requires course 09 to remain dynamic-import-only and blocked until a verified Bauman syllabus is supplied.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Reserve a fail-closed dynamic import surface; do not invent static subjects.
